visualTheme.description: Choose the appearance shared by all Dirty Plugins. Native Stash cards and players keep their Stash theme.

showSettingsInMenu.displayName: Show settings in the Stash header
showSettingsInMenu.description: Add a Dirty Plugins settings button after the other Dirty plugin buttons in Stash's utility navigation.

useNavHub.displayName: Group Dirty Plugins in Nav Hub
useNavHub.description: Move visible Dirty Plugins navigation buttons into Nav Hub's Plugins menu. Use Nav Hub's Manage controls to choose which buttons it groups.
